data.body: [P1] The guard depends on the earlier, eventually consistent preflight result. Concurrent deliveries or a rerun before the first push propagates can both set `BUILT_THIS_RUN=true` and reach this mutable push; because they share per-architecture tags, the later run can silently replace an already-published release with different digests. Hold a per-version lock across building and publication, use run-scoped architecture tags, and reconcile `latest` by copying the exact existing version manifest.
